newsitem.title: UK: Bowthorpe says strong pound could hurt H1.
newsitem.headline: Bowthorpe says strong pound could hurt H1.

text.p: British electronics group Bowthorpe Holdings Plc said on Wednesday that the year had started with an underlying growth in order intake, but cautioned that sterling's strength could hurt earnings in the first half.
Bowthorpe pretax profit fell to 72.9 million stg in 1996, after a provision of 8.5 million stg for closure costs, compared with 77.5 million stg in 1995.
The company's 1996 results also included a currency translation loss of 1.3 million stg versus a gain of 2.0 million stg in the previous year.
"The recent strengthening of sterling, if maintained, will impact on the group through translation, especially in the first half," the company said in a statement.
Bowthorpe recommended a final dividend of 6.96p per share, up seven percent from the year-ago level, bringing the total dividend to 10.17p for 1996.
Bowthorpe's shares gained 12.5p to 401 by 1015 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
